name: 10506 · Bedford, NY
findings: ZIP 10506 (Bedford) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10506 (Bedford) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: 14 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
